limitations: Offline synthetic cameras/radar, ellipsoid hull, constant reference mass, zero planning delay. Actor/COM scoring alignment is additionally tested in the actual-loop API double. Native verification and 60+ score remain pending.
decision: Retain original Momentum startup. Broader routes require mature tracking, a settled burn, a meaningful modeled benefit and a fuel estimate below 47.5 kg. Adopt scoring-origin targeting, first-entry-only hull checks and deeper terminal targeting for capture reliability. The small average modeled score decrease is disclosed.
